notablePrerequisites:
There is an artifact or creature on the battlefield.
You have enough mana to cast Stolen Identity
description:
Cast Stolen Identity by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature or artifact.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Stolen Identity, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Stolen Identity, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
